title: Air Force lieutenant colonel makes Marines sign an NDA and threatens execution

tellings.quote: And then um he told me flat out that if you talk about this, you can go to prison or you can be executed over it.

plain: Around 2009 or 2010, at Camp Hansen, a Marine base on Okinawa in Japan, an Air Force lieutenant colonel had a group of Marines sign a non-disclosure agreement, a pledge of secrecy, covering what they had seen in Indonesia, and warned them of the price of talking. Michael Herrera, a former Marine who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says he was one of them and was told "flat out that if you talk about this, you can go to prison or you can be executed over it." He says the paper was a top secret agreement tied to the Indonesia event, which would mean the government treated what they saw as a guarded secret.
